Subject: Follow-up: Security discovery & pen test request — next steps and SLA

Hi Jessica — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Call highlights:
- Cardinal HealthTech is in procurement for a pilot using Redwood Dedicated for PHI workloads (HIPAA scope).
- You requested SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA posture, and examples of past pen test reports (redacted).
- We covered our typical vulnerability management flow and wanted to confirm acceptable SLAs/scanning cadence with your security team.

Requested items from Cardinal:
1) Completed vendor security questionnaire (we can accept a Word/PDF).
2) SOC 2 artifacts (Type II preferred; Type I acceptable as interim).
3) Confirmation whether we can run authenticated scans (agent or credentialed) against staging hosts.
4) NDA to exchange redacted pen test reports.

Our asks / proposal from Redwood:
- We will share a PenTest SOW + vulnerability management roles matrix (attached once you confirm NDA).
- Proposed remediation SLAs: Critical — 72 hours; High — 7 days; Medium — 30 days.
- Suggested scanning cadence: external network quarterly, authenticated app scans monthly for core services during pilot, annual full-scope engagement.
- Coordinated disclosure: share reports under NDA; coordinated disclosure window 30 days after report unless active exploitation is observed.

Next steps:
- Jessica: please share vendor questionnaire + SOC artifacts and indicate whether credentialed scans are allowed (staging).
- We'll upload the PenTest_SOW_v1 and Vuln_Management_Roles once you confirm NDA (we can sign yours or send ours).

Thanks — looking to move this quickly so procurement and legal can align.

Best,
Diego Fernandez

Jessica — appreciate the quick turnaround and the completed questionnaire. Attaching the two documents we discussed for your review: PenTest_SOW_v1.pdf (high-level scope and deliverables) and Vuln_Management_Roles.xlsx (internal roles + suggested escalation path).

Summary of items in the SOW (high level):
- Scope: external network perimeter + authenticated app scan for staging + limited web app business-critical endpoints.
- Deliverables: executive summary, technical findings (redacted on request), remediation guidance, retest verification after fixes.
- Timeline: typical engagement 2–3 weeks from kickoff.

Proposed SLA (same as the call, stated explicitly in SOW):
- Critical (RCE, data exfiltration possibility): 72 hours to mitigation plan / temporary mitigation; retest within 7 days.
- High (auth bypass, access escalation): 7 days to mitigation plan.
- Medium: 30 days.

Scanning cadence options we recommend for the pilot (pick one):
A) Conservative: external quarterly, authenticated staging monthly (preferred for PHI pilot).
B) Aggressive: external monthly, authenticated staging biweekly (for higher-risk apps).

Coordinated disclosure language we propose (included in SOW): vendors provide redacted report under NDA; if an active exploit is observed we reserve the right to notify immediately and require immediate remediation. Otherwise coordinated disclosure window 30 days post-report.

Attachments: PenTest_SOW_v1.pdf, Vuln_Management_Roles.xlsx

Can you confirm: 1) which scanning cadence option you prefer, and 2) we'll sign your NDA or you can sign ours — which would you like?
